description: This file defines the GrainId struct, which uniquely identifies a grain in Orleans. It includes methods for creation, parsing, serialization, comparison, and hashing, along with a JSON converter for serialization purposes.

classes.name: GrainId
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a grain in Orleans, supporting serialization, comparison, and parsing.

classes.name: GrainIdJsonConverter
classes.description: A JSON converter for serializing and deserializing GrainId instances to/from JSON strings.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a GrainId from a string type and key.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a GrainId from a ReadOnlySpan<char> or string.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId from a string or span without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Generates a stable hash code for the GrainId suitable for cluster-wide use.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares the GrainId with another for ordering.
